name: vendiconnect-system
description: VendiConnect Full Stack Monorepo (Bot, Backend, Resident App, Admin Dashboard)

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "BACKEND,BOT,RESIDENT,ADMIN" -c "blue,green,magenta,yellow" "cd Backend && npm run dev" "node index.js" "cd Frontend/ResidentApp && npx expo start" "cd Frontend/AdminApp && npx expo start --port 8082"
